run_turk_task_with_qualifications: run a mephisto crowdsourcing task on MTurk with allowlist and softblock qualification filters
create_shared_static_task_state: create a SharedStaticTaskState with qualification rules requiring an allowlist qual to exist and a softblock qual to not exist
launch_task_run_with_operator: launch a task run using the mephisto Operator with a config and shared task state
load_db_and_process_config: load the mephisto database and process the OmegaConf DictConfig for task execution
wait_for_runs_then_shutdown: wait for all task runs to complete then shut down the operator with periodic logging
